text.en: Uma’s guide identifies an Elias Angeles halo-halo shop.
The guide calls it Naga’s oldest halo-halo shop; an opening date is not established.
A 2011 visitor also described Ice Blink’s mami and toasted siopao.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: independent business POI
sources.note: Point copied from the mapped business node. It marks the business approximately within a shared footprint; it does not identify a building or entrance.
